summary: Frontend-only testing (Playwright, mostly 390x844, plus a 1920 check) of the zone Quick add cupboards form, names unique per zone, the Store-photo tick on single and batch Magic Scan, the zone heading photo icon, the folded Zone Map Photos list and the 'Put inside another cupboard' dialog. Used the pro account (test_session_pro_1) on boat 'main', which already has zones from its overview map (Galley has 2 Zone Map Photos). Every feature in the request passed. (1) Quick add (Forward cabin): an empty name gives 'Please enter the cupboard name'. Added 2 cupboards, one with a location; chips show and the button reads 'Add another'. Done only appears after the first add. A duplicate name in any casing gives '<typed> is already in Forward cabin'. Done closes the dialog and only the Blue group stays open (Orange and none have aria-expanded=false). The first new cupboard is open and scrolled to. The location shows on the row, in the edit dialog's where input, and in the DB as 'where'. (2) Unique per zone: 'TEST_Fire Extinguisher locker' was added in both Forward cabin and Starboard Aft cabin. Renaming to a name already in the same zone shows the error 'X is already in Forward cabin'. Renaming to 'Fridge' (only in Galley) is accepted. Moving with the zone button to a zone that already has the name shows the toast 'Forward cabin already has a TEST_Fire Extinguisher locker. Rename one of them first.' and the zone does not change. (3) Galley zone batch scan: the scan button comes before the quick form. The batch form shows the chips 'Your Galley cupboards' (Fridge, Pantry, 'TEST_Galley Empty Locker (empty)'). Picking a chip fills the name and location and shows 'already in Galley, empty. This scan fills it.'; a cupboard drops out of the chips once it is in the batch. batch-entry-store-photo-0 and -1 are ticked by default, and I unticked entry 1. Both real AI scans finished (2 found each). The empty existing cupboard needed no add/replace choice (no batch-entry-replace-0) and ticked fine. After Confirm, the kept-photo cupboard got inventory-area-photo-{id} and a photo in the DB. The unticked one has no photo. (4) Single scan: scan-review-store-photo is ticked by default. Kept ticked (on a cupboard with items, Replace): the photo icon appears and the DB has the photo. Unticked (empty cupboard, Save contents): items are saved, with no photo icon and no photo in the DB. (5) The heading icon inventory-colour-group-orange-photos is the only photos icon (only Galley has photos). The dialog grid has 2 thumbnails; -big opens and -big-close goes back to the grid. (6) zone-map-photos-toggle 'Zone Map Photos (2)' is aria-expanded=false with 0 zone-map-item-* shown; tapping it shows 2. (7) The merge button text is 'Put inside another cupboard'. With 4 groups, the -top Put inside/Cancel buttons come straight after the first group's cupboards and the bottom buttons are still there. Top Put inside is disabled until you pick a cupboard. Top Cancel closes the dialog, and top Put inside moved the cupboard (toast, and parent_id in the DB). (8) At 390px, document scrollWidth is 390 and the zone dialog is 370 wide with no horizontal overflow. All test cupboards were deleted through the UI; the boat's area ids match the snapshot taken before testing.

issues: Multi-word zone labels look like one word in the uppercase chip, e.g. 'HEADSAFT', 'FORWARDCABIN'. The space is in the text but hard to see with the display font and tracking-tight. Probably existed before this change; low priority.
The error repeats the name as typed (e.g. 'test_qa locker a is already in Forward cabin') instead of the existing cupboard's name. Cosmetic only.
Filling an empty existing cupboard is counted as 'replaced' ('1 boat area added, 1 replaced with 4 items'). 'filled' would read better for 0-item cupboards. Minor wording.

action_items: Optional: in the quick-add/addArea duplicate messages, show the existing cupboard's name instead of the typed one.
Optional: in the applyBatch toast, count an empty existing cupboard as filled or added, not replaced.

Optional: addSuggested/addAreasNamed (suggested cupboards, Zone Map pins) still check names across the whole boat (list.some(same name)), not per zone. That is fine for unzoned cupboards, but it doesn't match the new per-zone rule.
critical_code_review_comments: InventoryList.jsx is 501 lines and growing; consider extracting the zone and quick-add handlers into a hook.
When the single-scan Store photo stays ticked on a cupboard that already has a photo, that photo is replaced and the old area-photo file is left behind in storage (no delete call).
QuickCupboards: pressing Done while the name input still holds text that wasn't added throws it away without a word. Consider adding it automatically or warning.
The zone key is the colour (zoneKey = zones[id].colour). Two zones that share a colour would share one name scope. Probably fine, since colours are unique per zone.
seed_data_creation: Made only TEST_ cupboards on the pro boat main (TEST_QA Locker A, 2x TEST_Fire Extinguisher locker, TEST_Galley Empty Locker, TEST_Galley New Drawer) and deleted them all via the UI afterwards. 2 cupboard photos were uploaded to area-photos storage and are now orphaned. Used 4 AI scans of pro quota.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pro boat main zones come from the overview cba66e09 (Cockpit Gold, Saloon Green, Galley Orange, Nav station Navy, Forward cabin Blue, Starboard Aft cabin Purple, Heads Aft Copper, Lazarett, Transom). Only Galley has Zone Map Photos (2), so only the Galley zone dialog shows the scan button. Open Boat Inventory with window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mbp:open-list',{detail:'boatInventory'})) after pressing Escape. CAUTION: the selector [data-testid$=-all-btn] also matches the Reset All button; use [data-testid^=inventory-colour-group-][data-testid$=-all-btn]. Give the sync about 2-5s after edits before closing the page or checking the DB (db.user_boats owner_id test-user-pro, boat_id main, field areas). A file generated with PIL (/tmp/cup.jpg) worked for AI scans (2 items found).
